name: Venmo Credit Card

apr.notes: Variable purchase APR 18.74% (Account Type 1), 27.74% (Type 2) or 30.74% (Type 3) based on creditworthiness; cash advance APR 30.74%; penalty APR 34.24%. Cash advance fee $10 or 5%.

base_rate.description: 1% cash back on all other purchases.

categories.label: Dining and entertainment (an extra 1% when the transaction is split and paid back in Venmo)
Paying with Venmo online, paying a business on Venmo or paying for goods and services on Venmo

rewards.redemption_notes: Cash back is deposited daily into the linked Venmo account and can be used for payments, transfers or automatic crypto purchases.

notes: Issued by Synchrony Bank. The account agreement covers the Venmo Visa Signature Credit Card and the Venmo Visa Credit Card; the package is assigned on approval, so network_tier is none.
